title: Chapter 1471 - 13: Realization
content:
Chapter 1471 - 13: Realization

Chapter 1471: Chapter 13: Realization

Inside the Chaos Void.

Lord Mo Xu and several other temporal beings also noticed the terrifying entities from various time and space outside. Despite the dimensional barriers, they could still feel the overwhelming pressure, as if the heavens were collapsing.

In the vision of Lord Mo Xu and other temporal beings, it was impossible to observe any of these terrifying entities’ ’full appearances’; they could only vaguely see one anomaly after another.

Either infinite light, or splendidly colorful, or time and space distorted, or filled with everything.

"So many powerful beings?"

"Beings far surpassing the Time Lord? Are the collapsing timelines of darkness we observed due to them?"

Lord Mo Xu immediately reacted.

"Are these powerful beings coming for the Galaxy?"

Luo Hou couldn’t help but say, "They come with ill intent."

The other temporal beings remained silent.

Even a fool could see that these temporal beings came with ill intent.

Otherwise, how could they cause one timeline after another to collapse into darkness? And so many powerful beings coming together clearly had the implication of a ’palace coup.’

"Let’s see what the Galaxy does."

"No matter the outcome, we stand with the Galaxy."

Lord Mo Xu spoke up.

Over the years, due to Lin Yuan, they have enjoyed countless benefits.

Now that Lin Yuan is in crisis, with the enemy at their door, they naturally know what choice to make.

...

Outside the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan looked at each terrifying entity and smiled, "Shall we talk? How would you like to discuss?"

Nearing the end level of the path to transcendence, every move is enough to affect one timeline after another, rendering observations through the timeline of such entities impossible.

Thus, Lin Yuan could not foresee the outcome of his confrontation with so many terrifying entities.

But clearly, Lin Yuan felt the pressure.

These terrifying entities, under the drive of the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, could perfectly merge their powers, demonstrating an effect far beyond the simple sum of their parts.

As Lin Yuan spoke.

Over five hundred terrifying entities were also observing Lin Yuan.

They were curious about the calamity target that could prompt the Supreme Rule Dao’s will to gather them together, what kind of existence it really was.

"Can’t see through."

"I can’t see through either."

"But this Galaxy seems unwilling to have a direct conflict with us."

"Yes, he intends to negotiate with us."

Many terrifying entities breathed a small sigh of relief. If it could be resolved in a relatively ’peaceful’ manner, it would naturally be the best outcome.

As for forcibly threatening with power?

That would be a route with no retreat.

Who knows what terrible methods the Galaxy might possess, with even the Supreme Rule Dao’s will being so cautious. How could they dare to underestimate it?

"It’s very simple."

The terrifying entity emanating infinite light looked at Lin Yuan: "Please have the Galaxy Lord stop ascending the path to transcendence."

"This is a calamity decreed by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will. As long as the Galaxy Lord is willing to stop ascending the path to transcendence, we are willing to pay any price."

The terrifying entity with infinite light spoke with a slightly solemn tone: "If I can pass this calamity, I will have effectively transcended ten calamities, equivalent to completing the ’infinite calamities’ path to transcendence."

"By then, if I transcend, I will do my utmost to help the Galaxy transcend."

The terrifying entity radiating infinite light said earnestly.

"I will too."

"Galaxy Lord, if I can transcend, I will surely do my utmost to assist you."

"Yes, Galaxy Lord, please fulfill our request."

Each terrifying entity immediately promised.

If this calamity is successfully overcome, nearly twenty terrifying entities will be able to complete the ’infinite calamities’ path to transcendence.

The remaining terrifying entities kept their eyes on Lin Yuan, the promises they offered were by no means scant.

Promises from nearly twenty future transcenders?

Isn’t this more worthwhile than climbing the path to transcendence on one’s own?

After all, no one can be certain they can achieve transcendence.

"What you mean is for me to give up my own path to transcendence, to give you the opportunity?" Lin Yuan looked at the many terrifying entities with a faint smile.

As soon as the words fell, a terrifying entity spoke: "Galaxy Lord, it’s not about giving us the opportunity but changing the approach, can you guarantee that you can definitely transcend?"

"Right, attempting transcendence alone versus having transcenders assist you, is the difficulty the same?"

"Galaxy Lord, we hope you can weigh it carefully, perhaps the path to transcendence you are climbing is wrong."

Each terrifying entity spoke with great enthusiasm, seemingly considering Lin Yuan’s best interest.

"What if I refuse?"

Lin Yuan said with a calm tone.

Placing the hope of transcendence in the hands of others?

Isn’t this equivalent to handing one’s fate over to others?

Not to mention the ’infinite calamities’ path to transcendence likely cannot lead to transcendence.

Even if transcendence is possible, once these terrifying entities become transcenders, would they really willingly help Lin Yuan transcend?

True transcenders stand above everything, the so-called oaths, the so-called cause and effect, cannot constrain them at all.

"Refuse?"

The terrifying entity shining infinite light fell into a brief silence.

Other terrifying entities also fell silent.

The promises they made earlier were already their limit.

If even this was refused, it seems unnecessary to continue the negotiation.

"Or change the approach, you all give up undergoing the tribulation, allowing me to complete the path to transcendence. If I can transcend, I will certainly assist you in transcending, how about that?"

Lin Yuan countered.

With those words.

The many terrifying entities were left speechless in succession.

Naturally, they were unwilling to do so, with concerns similar to Lin Yuan’s.

Who knows if Lin Yuan would be willing to assist them in transcending once he transcends?

"You would also refuse, right?"
